text:
erin_pm: Heads-up: field asks landed for a flexible onboarding "grace" for pilots. Need quick alignment on scope and guardrails.

matt_h: From infra POV we can do a non-enforced grace window, but we need telemetry hooks and an auto-throttle design to avoid runaway cost.

lisa_engineering: Agree. Recommend trigger = 95th pct over 7d sliding window rather than daily peak. Easier to automate.

dina_product: Draft policy idea: 30-day onboarding grace (+10% over commit no throttle), then 60-day soft-limit with warnings and gentle throttles, then enforce commit. Exceptions for strategic pilots with finance waiver.

sanjay_sales: Acme pilot wants 90 days at +15%. They're worried about analytics bursts. Can we accommodate?

alex_finance: Modeled cost: for a $50k/mo commit, 30/60/90 day grace approximates to +12%/+20%/+28% cost to Redwood. 90 days is material.

billing-bot: Recent snapshot for Acme: avg 1.8M tokens/day vs commit 2.0M/day -> ~10% overage last week.

sam_growth: Customer research: majority expect some grace; a minority prefer trial credits. Suggest gating longer grace by ARR or strategic value.

matt_h: Implementation notes: need two flags in billing: `grace_expires_at` and `throttle_profile`. We can land safe defaults in 2 sprints; alerts + full dash in 3.

dina_product: Updated proposal (compact):
- Onboard: 30d, up to +10%, no throttle
- Transition: next 60d, warnings + soft 50% throttle on excess
- Post 90d: enforce commit + overage billing
- Strategic exception: up to 90d w/ manager approval + finance waiver (+25% overage rate)

lisa_engineering: We'll also need routing-layer enforcement to avoid hotspots. ETA for flags+basic dash = 2 sprints.

alex_finance: If exceptions allowed, recommend deposit or elevated overage rate. I'll draft numbers and waiver text.

sanjay_sales: If we take +25% overage for exceptions, Acme is likely ok. I'll confirm tomorrow.

erin_pm: Draft launch checklist: policy flags live, telemetry + alerts, finance overage matrix, legal clause for liability cap, sales pilot template + UI indicator for "grace remaining."

sam_growth: UX: add small console banner and counter "grace days remaining" increases transparency and reduces support churn.

dina_product: Also propose A/B pilot: cohort A = grace policy, cohort B = trial credits. Measure conversion and net MRR at 90/180d.

matt_h: Heads-up: small billing schema change may require brief maintenance window. Ops estimate 1 maintenance window.

erin_pm: Action items: @lisa_engineering confirm sprint dates; @alex_finance finalize overage delta for exceptions; @sanjay_sales confirm Acme terms; @dina_product write pilot contract + A/B plan; @sam_growth draft console copy. Reconvene next Tue to approve.

alex_finance: Will share draft by Thu EOD.

lisa_engineering: Confirmed: flags + basic dash = 2 sprints, full telemetry = 3 sprints.

sanjay_sales: Will confirm Acme by EOD tomorrow.

erin_pm: Thanks everyone. Logging this into the roadmap doc and creating a short PRD. :thumbsup:
